verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents APIs for cards, card expenses, bills and transfers, but nothing describes a universal search bar spanning transactions, vendors and cards, or a way to jump from search results into initiating a payment. Universal search is a fair axis for a business finance platform, so the absence of evidence makes this none, not na.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can search across all transactions, vendors, and cards from one universal search bar and jump straight into initiating a payment
